meta.description: Curated FrameNet vocabulary for DORIS framing annotation in KGExplorer Case 3 (News). Frame and FE names follow FrameNet (framenet.icsi.berkeley.edu); the lists are trimmed to news-relevant core frame elements and serve as the constrained vocabulary for DeepSeek annotation plus downstream validation - they are not linguistic ground truth.
meta.normalization: DeepSeek output is matched against these names case-insensitively, then fuzzily (difflib, cutoff 0.8). Unknown frames or FEs are dropped, and a frame with no resolvable entity element is dropped.
